description: Flat metadata schema for individual records generated from iPSC differentiation into neurons for neurodegenerative disease modeling, including donor genetics, differentiation protocol, batch variables, and neuronal phenotype readouts.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual metadata record or experimental sample.

donor_id.descr: De-identified identifier for the patient/donor from whom the iPSCs were derived.

cell_line_id.descr: Identifier for the iPSC cell line used in the experiment.

donor_disease_name.descr: Primary neurodegenerative disease associated with the donor, e.g. Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, or other specified disease.

donor_disease_status.descr: Disease status of the donor/cell line, e.g. affected, unaffected, carrier, or control.

known_pathogenic_variant.descr: Reported disease-linked genetic variant(s) present in the donor or cell line using HGVS or other standardized nomenclature.

variant_gene.descr: Gene name associated with the documented variant(s), using approved gene symbols when possible.

variant_classification.descr: Clinical or functional classification of the variant, e.g. pathogenic, likely pathogenic, risk allele, VUS.

genotype_notes.descr: Free-text notes on additional relevant genotype information, such as zygosity or multiple variants.

reprogramming_method.descr: Method used to generate iPSCs, e.g. Sendai virus, episomal vectors, mRNA, or other.

cell_source_type.descr: Original somatic cell source used for reprogramming, e.g. fibroblast, PBMC, or blood cell.

passage_number.descr: Passage number of the iPSC culture at the time of differentiation initiation.

karyotype_status.descr: Karyotype status of the iPSC line, e.g. normal, abnormal, or not assessed.

mycoplasma_status.descr: Mycoplasma testing result for the culture at the time of use, e.g. negative or positive.

differentiation_batch_id.descr: Identifier for the differentiation batch or run in which this record was generated.

differentiation_protocol_name.descr: Name or short identifier of the neuronal differentiation protocol used.

differentiation_protocol_version.descr: Version or revision identifier of the differentiation protocol.

differentiation_start_date.descr: Date the differentiation procedure was initiated, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

differentiation_duration_days.descr: Total duration of differentiation before endpoint collection, in days.

growth_factors_used.descr: Names of growth factors, morphogens, or small molecules used during differentiation, separated by semicolons if multiple.

growth_factor_concentrations.descr: Concentrations of growth factors or small molecules used, with units and mapping to the listed factors where possible.

timing_schedule.descr: Key timing information for media changes, factor additions/removals, or stage transitions, typically expressed in days or hours relative to differentiation start.

substrate_coating.descr: Surface coating or extracellular matrix used for neuronal culture, e.g. poly-D-lysine, laminin, Matrigel.

culture_media.descr: Basal media and supplements used during differentiation or maintenance, if relevant.

oxygen_condition.descr: Oxygen tension during culture, e.g. 20% O2, 5% O2, hypoxic, or normoxic.

temperature_celsius.descr: Incubation temperature in degrees Celsius during differentiation/culture.

phenotype_assay_name.descr: Name of the assay used to measure the neuronal phenotype, e.g. immunocytochemistry, patch clamp, calcium imaging, MEA.

phenotype_assay_timepoint_days.descr: Day(s) post-differentiation at which the phenotype assay was performed, in days.

neuron_identity_marker.descr: Markers used to confirm neuronal identity, e.g. MAP2, TUJ1, NeuN, SYN1.

neuron_maturity_stage.descr: Maturity stage of the derived neurons, e.g. progenitor, immature neuron, mature neuron.

neuronal_morphology_description.descr: Qualitative description of neuronal morphology, such as neurite outgrowth, soma size, branching, or complexity.

neurite_length_um.descr: Measured neurite length in micrometers (µm), if quantified.

branching_index.descr: Quantitative branching metric for neuronal processes, if measured.

synaptic_activity_description.descr: Qualitative description of synaptic activity, including spontaneous firing, burst behavior, or synapse formation.

synaptic_activity_measurement.descr: Quantitative measure of synaptic or electrophysiological activity, with units depending on assay (e.g. Hz, pA, spikes/min).

synaptic_activity_units.descr: Units for synaptic_activity_measurement, e.g. Hz, pA, spikes/min, or arbitrary units.

disease_phenotype_observed.descr: Whether a disease-relevant cellular phenotype was observed in this record.

phenotype_severity_score.descr: Numeric severity score or effect size for the observed disease phenotype, if applicable.

therapeutic_intervention_applied.descr: Indicates whether a therapeutic intervention or candidate compound was applied to the culture.

therapeutic_agent_name.descr: Name of the therapeutic compound, gene perturbation, or intervention used, if applicable.

therapeutic_agent_dose.descr: Dose or concentration of the therapeutic agent, including units where appropriate.

therapeutic_treatment_timing.descr: Timing of therapeutic administration relative to differentiation or assay, e.g. day 10 to day 20.

control_condition.descr: Description of the matched control condition, e.g. isogenic control, untreated, vehicle-treated.

replicate_number.descr: Biological or technical replicate number for the record.

operator_id.descr: Identifier for the person or system that performed the experiment, if tracked.

instrument_platform.descr: Instrument or platform used for phenotype acquisition, e.g. microscope model, MEA system, or electrophysiology rig.

analysis_pipeline.descr: Software, script, or analysis workflow used to process the phenotype data.

data_file_name.descr: Name of the associated raw or processed data file for this record.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to interpretation, reproducibility, or exceptions in the experimental workflow.
